etsy.title: Sagittarius Zodiac Poster, Minimalist Astrology Wall Art, Sagittarius Birthday Gift, November December Birthday Decor
etsy.description:
A minimalist Sagittarius zodiac poster with the Sagittarius glyph, the November 22 – December 21 date range, and three traits: adventurous, optimistic, and blunt.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a bedroom, gallery wall, or as a birthday gift for a Sagittarius (November 22 – December 21).

This listing is a physical poster print, for entertainment purposes only. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Sagittarius results show centaur/archer art, affirmation grids, and skeptic humor; November 22 - December 21 matches this poster.
Most are printables; physical framed prints run about $20-40+ in snippets.
Most single-sign Etsy results are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Minimalist glyph-only sign prints exist but are mostly A4/A5 printables; the common styles are constellations, gradient 'aura' circles, and illustrations.
Amazon zodiac titles spell out size plus 'unframed' and the room (bedroom, living room, office); 12-sign sets, canvases, and tin signs crowd the results.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. 'sagittarius zodiac poster' is the sign-plus-product phrase in competitor titles and the query run; sign tags use the glyph, dates, and traits printed on this poster. Birth-month phrasing follows competitors' month-based birthday titles. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical, unframed prints from framed prints and digital downloads.
